title: Gloves of Belligerent Skies

sources.title: Thunderous Conversion
markers: | description = When the wearer deals {{DamageType|Thunder}}, {{DamageType|Lightning}}, or {{DamageType|Radiant}} damage, inflict 2 turns of {{Cond|Reverberation}} upon the target(s).

summary: Deal Thunder, Lightning or Radiant damage to apply 2 turns of Reverberation.

fields.Reverberation: Each turn gives −1 to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves. At 5 or more turns, it deals 1d4 Thunder and a DC 10 Constitution save avoids Prone for 2 turns. Reverberation clears afterward.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Thunderous Conversion: Deal Thunder, Lightning or Radiant damage to apply 2 turns of Reverberation. Triggers once per attack. For area attacks, only the first target in the combat log receives it.
fields.Reported behavior: The status can apply to Thunder-immune creatures. The five-stack effect may fail in real-time mode. Lightning Charges and Phalar Aluve: Shriek trigger this item only under Honour rules. Moonbeam does not trigger it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
